title: Looped Uniform Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.30066v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Uniform diffusion language models (UDLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising sequences of ordinary vocabulary tokens, any of which may be corrupted and subsequently revised. During training, UDLMs must denoise from a context that may itself be unreliable, whereas masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) always condition on a clean context. This challenging training objective makes UDLMs more FLOP-intensive to train than MDLMs, but it yields stronger downstream reasoning performance. Recently, selective looping, which recursively applies a few early Transformer layers within each denoising step, has been shown to improve training efficiency in MDLMs under an iso-FLOP budget. We investigate looping in UDLMs while keeping the training objective and sampler unchanged. translated_title: 循环均匀扩散语言模型
translated_abstract: 均匀扩散语言模型（UDLM）通过迭代去噪普通词表token序列来生成文本，其中任意token都可能被破坏并随后被修订。在训练过程中，UDLM必须在可能不可靠的上下文上进行去噪，而掩码扩散语言模型（MDLM）始终以干净的上下文为条件。这种具有挑战性的训练目标使得UDLM的训练比MDLM更耗费FLOP，但能带来更强的下游推理性能。最近，选择性循环——即在每一步去噪中递归应用若干早期Transformer层——已被证明可以在等FLOP预算下提升MDLM的训练效率。我们在保持训练目标和采样器不变的情况下，研究了UDLM中的循环机制。我们发现循环能显著提升训练效率：循环UDLM达到了在约0.5万亿token上训练的非循环UDLM的验证NLL水平……
tldr: 该论文首次将循环机制（在每步去噪中递归复用早期Transformer层）引入均匀扩散语言模型，在不改变训练目标和采样器的情况下显著提升训练效率，使循环UDLM以更少计算量即可达到非循环模型训练约0.5万亿token后的验证NLL水平。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces looping—recursively applying a few early Transformer layers within each denoising step—into uniform diffusion language models (UDLMs), showing that with the training objective and sampler unchanged, looped UDLMs significantly improve training efficiency and match the validation NLL of a non-looped UDLM trained on roughly 0.5 trillion tokens.
